content.text: The Cubs look to bounce back from a loss on Tuesday night when they visit the Phillies in Philadelphia The Chicago Cubs battle the Philadelphia Phillies in the second game of a three-game series on Tuesday night. The Cubs lost the first game of the series 13-7 and are looking to even the series in the middle game on Tuesday night. The Cubs struggled on Monday night as they fell behind 13-2 after seven innings before they finally got their bats going in the eighth inning. It wasn’t enough, though, and they have now lost three of their last four games to fall to 7-9 on the season. Tuesday, they will send Riley Martin to the mound. Martin has pitched in three games this season, but he has yet to make a start. He has pitched just 3.1 innings, but has yet to give up a run.
